title: Unforeseen technical fault, six-hour delay, long haul
narrative: Six hours late into Nairobi because something broke on the plane. The airline told me sudden technical faults are outside their control.

documents.content:
BOOKING LP08KD — Passenger: S. IVANOVA (adult)
Carrier: Lyra Pacific (LP)
LP771  AMS 02 Sep 2026 21:15  ->  NBO 03 Sep 2026 07:40
Single booking reference. Great-circle distance AMS-NBO: 6,635 km.
Status: CONFIRMED.
BOARDING PASS LP771 02SEP2026 — IVANOVA/S — seat 34K — boarded 21:02Z

NBO ARRIVALS — LP771 03SEP2026
Scheduled on-blocks 07:40 local
Actual on-blocks 13:46 local
Delay at final destination: 6h 06m

LYRA PACIFIC OPS LOG — LP771 / 02SEP2026
Status: DELAYED 06:06
Cause code: TECH-UNSCH
Cause text: Unscheduled maintenance. Bleed air valve fault detected by LP line maintenance during pre-departure checks at AMS. Part sourced from LP stores, replaced, aircraft returned to service.
No manufacturer or regulator directive associated with this defect.

derivation: S2.1(b) 6h 06m at final destination, at or over 3h30m
S3.2(a) technical fault, explicitly including unforeseen faults -> carrier-controlled
S3.4 fault found by carrier's own maintenance, not a manufacturer/regulator directive -> not S3.3(g)
S4.6 notice ladder does not apply to delays
S5.4 6h 06m is at or over 5 hours -> no taper
